# Plugin.Maui.RetryQueue

Retry failed operations in .NET MAUI. Enqueue a named call, persist it, and retry with 30s / 2min / 10min backoff, jitter, network awareness, cancellation, and a dead-letter queue.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.RetryQueue
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.RetryQueue
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-retry-queue
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+), net10.0-maccatalyst (15+), net10.0-windows (10.0.17763+; packed on Windows)

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, and Windows. The Windows TFM is included when the package is packed on Windows.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.RetryQueue

Registration: `UseMauiRetryQueue` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I retry a failed MAUI API call with 30s / 2min / 10min backoff?
- MAUI retry queue for telemetry / analytics / orders / payments
- Dead-letter queue for failed mobile operations

## Do not use when

- You need typed jobs, priority queues, and delayed work — that is Plugin.Maui.JobQueue
- You need the OS to wake the app — that is Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks
- You only need HttpClient retry on a single request — that is Polly or Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience
